instruction: Candid medium-shot documentary photograph of an indoor room with decorative wall tiles. On the left, the curly-haired woman in the white blouse (R1) stands in profile, reaching her arms forward. On the right, the straight-haired woman in the black blazer (R2) faces her, extending her arms to initiate a warm embrace. The two women smile as they step closer together. The scene is captured with bright, natural indoor light and soft shadows.
